'''Ptooielama''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Slobberlama]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Blechlama]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ptooielama's messy fur might be hiding moldy cookies and long-lost socks. But when in trouble, you can bet that you're getting the stickiest, yet gentlest nuzzle."

Ptooielama is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

==Evolution Trial==
Ptooielama's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Blechlama]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 45,000 pinballs.
* Obtain 60 [[Card Album|cards]] from card packs.
